caseNameFull: Aiken, Administratrix v. Lucas, Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Mr. L. Karlton Mosteller for petitioner. Solicitor General Thacher, Assistant Attorney General Youngquist, Messrs. Claude R. Branch and J. Louis Monarch for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit in this case is granted, limited to the questions concerning the validity and effect of the waivers.
